neighbours.label: the slot right before 'angle': the modifier after 'at' in 'at an odd / a right / a steep ___ angle' (predicts 'angle')
fire: The old fence post was leaning at a sharp angle after the storm.
Hold the brush at a slight angle to the canvas.
His wrist was bent at an unnatural angle after the fall.
The rocket climbed at a shallow angle over the sea.
Saw the plank at a forty-five degree angle for the joint.
Her hat sat at a jaunty angle on her curls.
The beam of light entered the prism at a low angle.
The two roads meet at a right angle near the church.
quiet: The old fence post was leaning on the barn after the storm.
Hold the brush in a loose grip near the canvas.
His wrist was bent at an unusual moment during the match.
The rocket climbed at a steady pace over the sea.
Saw the plank at a slow speed for a cleaner joint.
Her hat sat at a jaunty tilt in the old photograph, people said.
The beam of light entered the prism at a low cost to the lab.
The two roads meet at a busy junction near the church.

notes: Card top examples peak on ' at', ' an', ' odd', ' right' just before 'angle'; output direction (- pole) promotes ' angle'. Probe: 'at an odd angle' 1.0 vs 'at an odd hour' 0.29.
